description: Vetted property calculators for Revit models read through Rhino.Inside.Revit. Design Grammars assembles generated scripts from these templates first; only a property no template covers gets a calculator the LLM writes under the contract of property_calculator_llm (validated AST, read-only model helpers).

revit_category_intersection_count.summary: Number of elements of the given Revit categories whose solid intersects the box solid (bounding-box overlap when the box has no solid).

revit_openings_below_count.summary: Number of door/window openings in the wall the box intersects whose extent along the wall overlaps the box and whose head is at or below the box bottom.

revit_min_opening_clearance_mm.summary: Minimal clear distance, in the plane of the wall the box intersects, between the box outline and the outline of any door/window opening in that wall; the sentinel when the wall has no opening.

categoryClassesDescription: The DG class each Revit category a calculator reads stands for. DG creates these classes in the project OntoGraph (with revitCategories) and links them to the calculator with READS_CLASS.

vocabulary.meaning: number of beams (structural framing) the element intersects
vocabulary.meaningRu: число балок, которые пересекает элемент (отверстие в балке)

vocabulary.meaning: number of columns the element intersects
vocabulary.meaningRu: число колонн и пилонов, которые пересекает элемент (отверстие в колонне)

vocabulary.meaning: number of walls the element intersects
number of floors/slabs the element intersects
vocabulary.meaningRu: число перекрытий и плит, которые пересекает элемент

vocabulary.meaning: number of door/window openings directly below the element in its host wall
vocabulary.meaningRu: число дверных и оконных проёмов прямо под элементом в его стене (отверстие над проёмом)

vocabulary.meaning: smallest clear distance from the element to a door/window opening in its host wall
vocabulary.meaningRu: наименьшее расстояние от элемента до дверного или оконного проёма в его стене, мм

classVocabulary.meaning: a box placed for an MEP opening in a wall or slab (Revit Generic Model mapped by DG)
structural column; a pylon modelled as a wall is mapped to Column

classVocabularyDescription: Preferred class names for words a rule uses in plain language. A rule never has to name a class or property: the ingest maps these words to the classes and the computable properties above.
openingCategoriesNote: Door and window openings only. OST_SWallRectOpening is the opening the structural engineer cuts from a box; counting it would make a box measure itself (owner 2026-10-20).
